column1: # smoke.cfg depth is "-" (not enforced): TLC's reported BFS depth overshoots
# by a level when workers race (measured 25 at -workers 2, seen 25 and 26 at
# -workers auto on identical input, distinct=426976 stable across both;

# exactly enforced. See check_bands in scripts/check-tla.sh for the sentinel.
